state_contract.sheep: idle/graze → alert → startle → flee → recover → idle/graze; captured holds last frame
state_contract.wolf: stalk requires stalking; feed requires feeding; retreat faces threat while moving backward
state_contract.shepherd_dog: bark/pressure express deterrence; their animation events never directly inflict damage

phase_policy.non_loop_actions: start at frame 0 when state is entered

event_policy: frame_index is zero-based; frame_1based is for humans; game logic validates contact
timing_note: PNG/source/HTML use exact milliseconds; GIF timing is rounded cumulatively to 10 ms.

species.label: 羊
notes: 每方向58帧；五个基础视角分别构造头部可见面及四足布局，其余三个由水平像素镜像获得。
北向不显示面部眼睛；南向使用居中正脸，斜向拥有独立头部与耳朵轮廓。
原地动画：脚底pivot固定，真实位移、受惊触发、捕获判定与草量消耗由游戏状态驱动。
待机与觅食建议按实体稳定随机种子错开播放相位，不能全群同时从第1帧开始。
起跑末帧匹配逃跑首帧，恢复末帧匹配待机首帧；捕获末帧保持，不自动回到待机。
被捕获使用无血腥的屈腿、侧倒、闭眼与停止主动运动表达失去行动能力。

species.label: 牧羊犬
notes: 48 frames per direction, eight directions; e/se/s/n/ne authored independently, opposite diagonal/side directions mirrored.
Blue pixels belong only to the neck collar; no harness.
Seven semantic layers, fixed 40x40 canvas and (20,34) ground anchor before mirroring.
All animation is in-place; do not use bark or pressure events as automatic damage triggers.
Frontal/back views have independently drawn heads and limb projection; n has no visible eyes or front muzzle.
